notes: Louis-Vincent Gave is the Founding Partner and CEO of GaveKal, a leading independent provider of macro research, and GaveKal Capital, manager of $2 billion in assets. Louis is one of my go-to sources for strategic research. He came on the show earlier this year to discuss the conflict in Ukraine, and that conversation is replayed on the feed. This time around, we cover Louis' perspective on the bear market and its transition of leadership from developed to emerging markets. We discuss emerging markets, the U.S. dollar, age of weaponization, deglobalization, China, and where to invest to weather the storm.  Louis-Vincent Gave is the Founding Partner and CEO of GaveKal,
a leading independent provider of macro research, and GaveKal
Capital, manager of $2 billion in assets. Louis is one of my go-to
sources for strategic research. He came on the show earlier this
year to discuss the conflict in Ukraine, and that conversation is
replayed on the feed.

This time around, we cover Louis’ perspective on the bear market
and its transition of leadership from developed to emerging
markets. We discuss emerging markets, the U.S. dollar, age of
weaponization, deglobalization, China, and where to invest to
weather the storm.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
